column1: # One row defines one source. Set enabled=TRUE to include it in the next build.
#   1. Set enabled=TRUE for each packaged source you want to include.
#   2. To add your own files, add a row with source_dir=00.setup and fill the
#      appropriate input_list, fasta_file, or metadata_file column.
#   3. Keep source_label unique among sources enabled in the same build.
# HOW TO POPULATE THE COLUMN FIELDS
#   A unique label for the dataset, internal row key only — never appears in the output FASTA/metadata.
#   Indicates whether this input row should be included in the build
#   Written into every protein's FASTA header (src_db=) and the metadata >source< column.
#   Must be unique across any sources that could be enabled together in the same build.
#   Written into every protein's FASTA header (group=).
#   A coarser bucket than source_label — for downstream grouping/summary tables.
#   Common source_dir values: 99.prepackaged_inputs (curated inputs shipped with maniFasta) | 00.setup (your own run-specific files)
# MODULE  (what kind of source is this row?)
#   mod_I    proteome / genome accessions  → input_list only
#   mod_III  ready-made FASTA file         → fasta_file (+ optional metadata_file)
#   mod_IV   built-in supported collection → collection (no input_list/fasta_file)
# COLLECTION  (mod_IV rows only — which built-in collection to fetch)
#     genomic_refseq_version=<e.g. V11.03>  falls back to the VERSION column if omitted
#     rank=species|genus|family             1 representative genome per group (omit = no dereplication)
# OPTIONS  (mod_I / mod_II rows — which backend to fetch from)
#   uniparc/pdb are protein-accession-only backends → mod_II rows only
#   A per-row fetch_source column inside the input_list file itself overrides
#   this for individual rows (lets one file mix backends).
#   version / citation / notes are free text, for your own reference only
